WITH pair_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    f.orderslink,
    u.acctscope,
    AVG(f.feerate) as avg_feerate
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope
),
all_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_feerate) as mean_avg 
  FROM pair_averages
),
filtered_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    p.orderslink,
    p.acctscope,
    p.avg_feerate,
    (p.avg_feerate - am.mean_avg) as excess
  FROM pair_averages p
  CROSS JOIN all_mean am
  WHERE p.avg_feerate > am.mean_avg
),
ranked_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    orderslink,
    acctscope,
    avg_feerate,
    excess,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC) as rank_in_scope
  FROM filtered_pairs
)
SELECT 
  orderslink,
  acctscope,
  avg_feerate,
  excess,
  rank_in_scope
FROM ranked_pairs
WHERE rank_in_scope <= 3
ORDER BY acctscope, rank_in_scope;
